say:3:1422633002:1.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Captain Indris. Since the Lightbearer Empire and Sal'thorin have not yet established formal diplomatic relations, I appreciate this opportunity to talk as private individuals.
say:3:1422633002:1.source_cn: 因度厄先生，幸会。由于耀光与萨洛克兰尚未建立正式外交关...

say:4:1422633003:0.text: Please just call me Evie. I'm curious why you're here together.
say:4:1422633003:0.source_cn: 请直接称呼我为伊芙即可。不过，我很好奇，您二位一同前来...

say:5:1422633004:2.text: Sal'thorin is currently dealing with an increasing number of the corrupted. We believe that the recent attacks on Brimstone Village are related.
say:5:1422633004:2.source_cn: 实际上，我们是为了处理孽化者增多的问题。我们相信，深岩...

choice_prompt:6:1422633004.text: Sal'thorin is currently dealing with an increasing number of the corrupted. We believe that the recent attacks on Brimstone Village are related.
choice_prompt:6:1422633004.source_cn: 实际上，我们是为了处理孽化者增多的问题。我们相信，深岩村最近遭受的袭击事件与此有直接关联。

say:7:1422633005:0.text: So, you're saying that the current attacks are just a precursor. There could be a sudden mass attack of these crazed creatures pouring out from the ground... That's too scary to imagine.
say:7:1422633005:0.source_cn: 孽化、诅咒……如果无法控制，就会有许多疯狂的怪物从地底...

say:8:1422633006:1.text: The reality is that Brimstone's defensive capabilities are woefully inadequate. Even the Heroic Order would struggle against a threat of this magnitude.
say:8:1422633006:1.source_cn: 别说缺乏战斗力的深岩村了，恐怕就连我们的耀光骑士团也难...

choice_prompt:9:1422633006.text: The reality is that Brimstone's defensive capabilities are woefully inadequate. Even the Heroic Order would struggle against a threat of this magnitude.
choice_prompt:9:1422633006.source_cn: 别说缺乏战斗力的深岩村了，恐怕就连我们的耀光骑士团也难以应对这样的灾难。

say:10:1422633007:0.text: Well, this is a win-win situation, isn't it? I'll leverage every resource at my disposal to help. What do you need?

choice_prompt:11:1422633007.text: Well, this is a win-win situation, isn't it? I'll leverage every resource at my disposal to help. What do you need?
choice_prompt:11:1422633007.source_cn: 这是双赢，我会在职权范围内全力相助，请问有什么是我能帮上忙的吗？

say:12:1422633008:0.text: So, you're planning to go to the Vaduso Mountains. You can use my ship if you want.
say:12:1422633008:0.source_cn: 您打算前往瓦度索山脉那里寻求帮助吗？如果是这样，不妨使...
say:12:1422633008:0.male: So, you're planning to go to the Vaduso Mountains. You can use my ship if you want.
say:12:1422633008:0.female: So, you're planning to go to the Vaduso Mountains. You can use my ship if you want.

say:13:1422633009:1.text: You've been on it. It's faster and more reliable than most ships. For an urgent mission like this, time is everything, and she'll serve you well.
say:13:1422633009:1.source_cn: 你们试过的，它比大部分船都更快也更稳定。对于这样紧急的...

say:14:1422633012:0.text: I'll be staying in Brimstone Village for a while, so you can use my ship as much as you like.
say:14:1422633012:0.source_cn: 至于我，我还会在深岩村停留一段时间，所以诸位可以随意使...

say:15:1422633013:0.text: I hope your efforts will soon uncover a means to break this curse so there is peace and security for both sides.
say:15:1422633013:0.source_cn: 希望你们能尽快找到解除诅咒的方法，为双方的和平与安宁做...

say:16:1422633014:0.text: Thank you, Evie. Sal'thorin won't forget the Empire's help. We're deeply grateful.
say:16:1422633014:0.source_cn: 衷心感谢你的慷慨相助，伊芙。萨洛克兰也不会忘记耀光的援助。
